reviews.name: Emily Watson
reviews.title: UV-C light actually kills dust mites — lab test proved it
reviews.body: We had our mattress and sofa tested before and after using this mite remover. The UV-C exposure at the certified 253.7nm wavelength reduced mite count by 97%. The photos show our mattress before and after treatment. Highly recommended for allergy sufferers.

reviews.name: David Kim
reviews.title: Great for mattresses and curtains — very effective against allergens
reviews.body: I have allergic rhinitis and have been looking for a non-chemical solution. This UV-C mite remover has significantly reduced my symptoms. The vibrating pad loosens dust and the suction pulls it away. One caveat: hold it in each spot for at least 30 seconds for maximum effect.

reviews.name: Patricia Souza
reviews.title: The HEPA filter inside captures everything — no more morning sneezing
reviews.body: Our bedroom smelled fresh after just 3 treatments. The HEPA filter is easy to remove and wash. The UV-C lamp replacement indicator is a useful feature. Ordered 200 units for our local store and they sold out in 6 weeks.
